name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
about: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd is primarily engaged in manufacturing and sale of forged components of automobiles, railway wagons & coaches and engineering parts. [1][2] It is the 2nd largest forging player in India.[3]
keyPoints: Market Leadership:[1] The company leads India’s forging sector. It holds the distinction of being the largest forging company in Eastern India and ranks amongst the top nationwide, supplying high-quality forged components to both domestic and international clients.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 28.5 days to 13.1 days
cons: Stock is trading at 3.91 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.47%
Company has a low return on equity of 9.75% over last 3 years.
